items.q: It was like bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo Perez. Leander Perez. Leander Perez.

ctx.x: It was a big difference in the people down there. Yeah. It was a kind of a dance. Yeah. It was a big difference. Yeah. It was like bamboo Perez. Leander Perez. Leander Perez. Oh, and there's a Nunes here. Yeah, it was. But that was down there. But that was down there, it was teetotard's difference from me. Yeah, they were civilized. So these was down here. I don't think I believe that I was fine with shaking. I believe I was having trouble on it with them. But I don't think they get a bad a-go out there, no.
Oh, no. Those are bad people. What about the Ninth Ward? How many musicians did they have around the Ninth Ward in those times? Well, Henry Ford, he was from down there, wasn't he?
